name: b33_route_v3
what: Waypoints for b33_drive.ps1 (W2DEV) v3.1b, PROPOSED from the DEV rehearsal surveys 1 and 2 (NOT-PREREG) and the DEV kerb survey v2. DIAGNOSTIC tool input, not evidence; path design for the drive, not a measurement threshold; the official route is fixed only by the B-9 survey addendum on the candidate. A waypoint is [x, y] or [x, y, expected soles z] (sender log frame, measured where given).

provenance.spawn: b33a sender spawn (-330,-650,22) yaw 56 (run_20261020T071219Z_b33a clientA log)
provenance.runway: research B33_RESEARCH_REPORT section 4: corridor x~0, y 0..2600 walked at z~10 [RECUSED-HINT origin: ledge_measure hop1/hop2]; the b33a RUN phase was pinned at a terrace wall near (729,864,85): this runway stays at x 0
provenance.m4: coordinator 2026-10-20 from W2DEV geometry survey v2 (dev_notes/m4_survey, DEV, teleports): the Dog STANDS on the +x north-end kerb top at soles z 113.0 (x +163, y 4450..4505); walking OUTWARD (+x, yaw 0) leaves it: drops 124.9 (y 4450), 111.5 (y 4480), 111.0 (y 4505); walking +y/-y along the kerb did not fall. Approach per research section 5: spawn -> (0,1000) -> (0,2600) -> flight y~2700-3300 -> path x 150..210 north -> kerb. v3: north on the path centre line x 0 from the flight top (0,3300) in legs of ~250 uu to (0,4380), a PRECISE corner east to (100,4380) on the path, then the mount taps NE onto the kerb top to (163,4468). x 0 north of y 3420 has NOT been walked on this build: an obstacle there gives NO-PROGRESS (a safe abort), a drop gives OFF-PATH.
provenance.m4_return: v3 = v2's return with measured z where walked: the slab corridor (z -11.8, rehearsal 1 at x 306.9-321, y 3557..4264); (350,3400) and (350,2600) NOT walked; (0,2600) z 9.4 (rehearsals 1/2). Verify with -Mode survey -SurveyReturn.
provenance.v3_basis: Rehearsal 1 (DIAGNOSTIC_b33_survey_20261020T222129Z) and rehearsal 2 (DIAGNOSTIC_b33_survey_20261020T225230Z, DEV harness wdevcmd2): both reached the flight top on x ~0 (z 72.6 at (6.3,3309.7); 76.3 at (1.7,3379.4) .. (59.4,3420.6)); both then went NE onto the RAISED EAST STRIP (z 88.8 at (142.8,3458.1), 93.4 at (178.5,3467.6), 93.9 at (174.5,3447.1)) and off its east edge at x ~190-215 (rehearsal 1: 88.7 at x 211.7 -> 35.7 -> -11.8 slab; rehearsal 2: 82.2 at x 218.2, 72.2 at 224.9, then a terrace at z ~35 for x 217-230, y 3500-3801). The kerb survey: the +x kerb top x 161-183 is z 106 (y 4005) .. 113 (y 4450-4505), the walk-off +x from x ~183 falls to x ~307. So the strip x ~140-195 is a RAISED EDGE ~15 uu above the path with a drop beyond; the path surface is between the kerbs, centred on x 0 (the DEV survey declaration: 'kerb tops at the north end of the raised garden path at x = +/-163').
provenance.calibration_v3: rehearsals 1 / 2 calibrated 6.044 / 5.468 counts/deg (one pass each, 10 % apart); v3.1b drive: 2 passes (+/-40), the mean, refuse if > 8 % apart; the post-turn heading is read over the last 700 ms of a 1.4 s walk (was 400 of 900).

counts_per_deg_prior_source: mp_auto_rule_v2.ps1 COUNTS_PER_DEG 700/166.4 (an earlier turn calibration of another build; unverified for this exe and mouse settings; the drive calibrates first)

jumps.runway_note: y 100..1900 keeps the jumps within ~0.8-2.6 k uu of the observer at spawn (camera yaw 56); passes turn 300 uu before each end
